question: NFL kickers made 99.3% of extra points before a 2015 rule pushed the kick back, then 94.2%. How many times more often did they miss?
move: When success is close to certain, compare the failures instead.
trap: Reading a five-point drop in success as a small change.
hint: Work out the share of kicks missed in each season first.
reference: Pro-Football-Reference, NFL Kicking statistics, 2014 and 2015 seasons, 2015
